Advertisers

Drive meaningful customer connections and business growth

Create, deliver, measure, and optimize ad experiences that people love

Run brilliant campaigns with our complete platform

Innovid’s solutions drive meaningful results and unlock incremental value when used together. Build personalized ad experiences with our creative tools. Scale your messaging with our omnichannel ad server. And prove the value of your campaigns with our measurement. By connecting technology, creative, and insights, you can optimize across channels, platforms, and devices. We help you turn intelligence into action, so each impression is more valuable than the last.

Talk with an expert about our powerful platform

Build creative that engages and excels

Using design software you know and love, you can easily build advanced creative that drives results. With Innovid’s dynamic creative optimization (DCO) solutions, you can personalize your messaging at scale based on data signals like geolocation, weather, and daypart. Innovid also enables you to quickly turn TV ads into a lean-forward experience with our interactive advertising formats that can feature QR codes, product galleries, and digital coupons. And with shoppable interactive ads, you can drive sales with store locators and add-to-cart buttons.

 Learn more about our advanced creative solutions

Efficiently deliver your ads everywhere

Our ad server helps you automate the delivery of seamless advertising experiences and reduce inefficiencies across channels at scale. Built for the challenging CTV environment, it also unleashes your marketing superpowers by providing data-driven intelligence across your entire media buy. You get unprecedented insight into the context and performance of your ad exposures to optimize and boost the value of your advertising investment.

Learn more about our independent ad server

Measure your advertising’s impact across channels

Every ad dollar you invest as a marketer has to deliver value. Prove ROI across devices, creative formats, and linear and CTV platforms with our measurement solutions. Measure reach, frequency, and outcomes — such as sales, app activity, web visits, and registrations — across your entire media buy. Gain a deep understanding of your campaigns and generate insights that help you realize your business objectives.

Learn more about our measurement solutions

Optimize your ad campaigns in real-time

When you combine Innovid’s solutions, you unlock the ability to optimize your campaigns across creative, ad serving, and measurement. Use our ad serving and measurement solutions together to gain automated, actionable insights to optimize your spending in real time. By combining creative and ad serving, you can personalize at scale with DCO and use first-party data to drive deeper engagement with interactive ads. And by combining measurement and creative, you can optimize using granular insights on what creative messages resonate via multivariate and A/B testing.

Nice to meet you

Innovid empowers the world’s top advertisers and publishers to create, deliver, measure, and optimize ad experiences that drive meaningful consumer connections and business growth.

Our story

Innovid is the leading independent omnichannel ad tech platform, empowering marketers to create, deliver, measure, and optimize ad-supported experiences that people love. In 2025, Innovid and Flashtalking merged to create a transparent, scalable alternative to big-tech, walled-gardens, and point solutions across CTV, digital, linear, and social channels. As part of Mediaocean, Innovid is tied into the industry’s core ad infrastructure for omnichannel planning, buying, and billing.
‍
We are proud to lead the industry with our innovation, intelligence, and independence as the company best-suited to power the future of advertising.

Meet the team

Zvika Netter
CEO & Co-Founder

Zvika Netter

CEO & Co-Founder

A career-long entrepreneur with a passion for innovation, Zvika Netter is the CEO & Co-Founder of Innovid — a leading software platform for the creation, delivery, measurement, and optimization of advertising across CTV, linear TV, and digital channels.

Zvika co-founded Innovid in 2007 and earned a patent the following year for inventing a method for inserting interactive objects into video content. He has overseen numerous milestones in Innovid’s rise, including the development of a video ad-serving platform in 2012, taking the company public in 2021, and acquiring TVSquared in 2022 to expand Innovid’s measurement capabilities.

In 2024, Zvika spearheaded the launch of Innovid’s Harmony initiative, designed to keep television open for everyone and controlled by no one. The initiative brings the industry together to address the biggest challenges facing CTV advertising – the need to improve efficiency, enhance transparency and control, reduce carbon emissions, increase ROI, and provide better viewing experiences.

With more than 20 years of digital media experience, Zvika sets the strategic direction for Innovid, with a focus on innovation and delivering value to shareholders, the world’s largest brands and publishers, and other partners in the digital and CTV ecosystems.

Zvika has been recognized by TIME as one of the “Tech Pioneers Who Will Change Your Life.” He was also named by the World Economic Forum as a “Technology Pioneer,” and by Businessweek as one of “Europe’s Young Entrepreneurs.” In addition to authoring numerous patents, he served in an elite computer unit in the Israeli Defense Forces. He also co-founded the non-profit organization GarageGeeks, an innovation hub with more than 8,000 members and one of Israel’s largest hacker spaces.

‍

Grant Parker
President

Grant Parker

President

Grant Parker is President at Innovid, leading the commercial teams and go-to-market for the company. Previously he was President at Flashtalking where he led the entire organization across product, engineering, sales, marketing, and client success.

Grant joined Mediaocean through the acquisition of 4C where he served as Chief Revenue Officer, helping establish the company as a leading social ads platform.

Grant has nearly 20 years of experience in the marketing and software industry, leading and coaching teams to successfully achieve growth through a repeatable process that helps clients transform their businesses and exceed their goals.

Grant began his career at Omnicom Media Group and also held media sales roles at Ziff Davis and Netshelter. He lives in the Chicago suburbs with his family and is a proud graduate of the University of Michigan.

Michal Livny
Chief People Officer

Michal Livny

Chief People Officer

Michal specializes in building incredible teams and operations for technology startups and currently oversees people management for our offices in Tel Aviv, London and Sydney. Previously, she helped a number of early-stage startups effectively grow as an HR consultant, was head of global human resources for a financial company, and also worked as a headhunter and managed the executive search department for one of the leading talent management and recruiting companies in Israel.

Amanda Glen Smith
Chief Client Officer

Amanda Glen Smith

Chief Client Officer

Amanda Glen Smith is the Chief Client Officer at Innovid following its merger with Flashtalking by Mediaocean. She leads strategic partnerships with Fortune 500 advertisers and agencies. Amanda is known for her can-do attitude and exceptional ability to deliver results.

Amanda's core values (relationships, integrity, excellence) guide her client success approach – she is service-oriented to drive business growth and achieve tangible client outcomes. Viewing herself as an extension of her clients' teams rather than merely a tech partner, Amanda maintains a consultative, strategic mindset that consistently drives remarkable results. Her impact has earned industry-wide recognition, including accolades from Gartner and G2 for best-in-class service.

In 2024, Amanda was selected as an honoree for the Cynopsis Top Women in Media Awards. Her achievements include spearheading initiatives to streamline client onboarding, expand service offerings, and optimize strategic planning, directly supporting clients’ evolving needs in a dynamic media landscape.

A graduate of the University of Texas at Austin and a Texas native, Amanda enjoys hosting gatherings around her dinner table and spending time with her husband and their two children.

Yuval Pemper
Chief Technology Officer

Yuval Pemper

Chief Technology Officer

Yuval is the Co-Chief Technology Officer at Innovid, where he leads the company’s global engineering team and is integral in developing Innovid’s product strategy, defining the technology roadmap, and introducing new products to the market.

Yuval has 20 years of experience leading research and development teams at companies throughout Israel and the world. Prior to Innovid, Yuval held engineering lead positions at Correlix, Alvarion, and OnSet Technologies. He also was the VP of Research and Development at Radware, a network application delivery and security firm. Yuval is a graduate of Tel Aviv University and resides in Israel.

Shamim Samadi
Chief Product Officer

Shamim Samadi

Chief Product Officer

Shamim Samadi currently oversees Product Strategy at Innovid. He previously co-founded and was Chief Product Officer at Beeswax which successfully exited Comcast's Freewheel in 2021. He previously held multiple product leadership roles at Google across YouTube monetization and Google’s Display & Video programmatic platforms on both the buy and sell side. 

Anthony Yam
EVP, Product Strategy

Anthony Yam

EVP, Product Strategy

Anthony is EVP of Product at Innovid, leading product innovation for the company’s ad management solutions. With nearly two decades of experience in digital advertising and creative technology, Anthony has played a pivotal role in shaping innovative ad tech products that drive efficiency and performance for global brands and agencies.

Before joining Innovid, Anthony served as SVP of Product at Flashtalking, where he led product innovation in dynamic creative optimization and ad serving. Prior to that, he was a cofounder and Chief Product Officer at Spongecell, a creative ad technology company that was acquired by Flashtalking. His early career includes engineering leadership roles at Ariba and Internet Security Systems, where he developed enterprise software solutions.

Anthony’s expertise spans dynamic creative, ad serving, identity resolution, and automation in digital advertising. He is passionate about building scalable, data- and AI-driven solutions that empower marketers in a rapidly evolving ecosystem.

Ken Markus
Chief Operations Officer

Ken Markus

Chief Operations Officer

Ken is the Chief Operating Officer at Innovid where he is responsible for the growth and scale of the company’s global client services organization. In this role, Ken spearheads efforts to enable brands to connect more deeply with their customers through personalized video experiences, while simultaneously bolstering the company’s current offering to traditional advertising agencies.

Ken previously served as the Senior Vice President of Global Operations and Client Services at Innovid, and prior to joining the Company, he was Head of Scale Operations and Services for gTech Ads at Google. Ken has also held positions at Condé Nast, SiriusXM Satellite Radio, and Time Inc.

Aaron Goldman
Chief Marketing Officer

Aaron Goldman

Chief Marketing Officer

Aaron is Chief Marketing Officer for Innovid and Mediaocean, leading a wave of initiatives across corporate marketing, communications, content, branding, and demand generation.

Prior to Mediaocean, Aaron ran global marketing for 4C (acquired by Mediaocean), Kenshoo (now Skai), and Resolution Media (now part of Omnicom).

Aaron has 25 years of industry experience and, in his spare time, you can find him posting clips of jam bands and trick shots on his YouTube channel @JudePerfect.

Mediaocean Introduces NIVO AI with Innovid Agents Driving 90% Improvement in Speed to Campaign Launch

June 11, 2026
•
5
min read
Share this post

NIVO AI Automates Workflows and Turns Intelligence into Action Across the Advertising Lifecycle

‍

NEW YORK – June 11, 2026 – Mediaocean, the foundational software and AI partner for omnichannel advertising, today announced the launch of NIVO AI, with Innovid agents already delivering workflow efficiency gains of up to 90% compared to manual campaign setup. The results came from pilot programs with brands and agencies, including Canvas, Fan Duel, Optimum, Paddy Power, and Tailwind.  

As AI reshapes the advertising landscape, NIVO turns intelligence into action by bringing together data, decisioning, and execution into a seamless, connected experience. For marketers, that means moving from idea to live, optimized campaigns in a fraction of the time. Campaigns can go live in minutes, with briefs, emails, and spreadsheets automatically transformed into ready-to-run execution. NIVO also enables teams to anticipate performance before budgets are spent and continuously optimize campaigns in-flight, all while providing instant answers and insights through natural language.

‍

A More Connected Model for Advertising

Built on Innovid’s omnichannel ad serving foundation, NIVO is the AI brain that bridges tools, teams, and workflows to ensure every signal leads to action, and every action drives performance.  

With the launch of NIVO, Innovid expands the agentic AI footprint it established last year with Orchestrator™. Specialized agents, powered by NIVO, execute across creative, delivery, measurement, and optimization, while Orchestrator connects everything to keep campaigns running smoothly.  

“NIVO thinks, Orchestrator connects, and Agents act,” said Zvika Netter, Chief Innovation Officer, Mediaocean, and CEO, Innovid. “The result is a virtuous cycle where campaigns launch faster, adapt in real time, and improve continuously.”  

"NIVO represents a shift from managing campaigns to orchestrating outcomes,” said Stephen Rubino, Media Operations Manager, FanDuel Group. “This will improve our internal efficiency allowing us to spend more time authentically speaking with our customers about their favorite sports.”

“What excites me about NIVO is its ability to turn insights into action,” said Raul Tafur, VP, Paid Social & Strategy, Canvas Worldwide. “Too often, teams spend time identifying opportunities but struggle to operationalize them at scale. NIVO has the potential to help brands move faster, reduce manual work, and focus more on strategic decision-making.”  

‍

Meet Innovid’s AI Agents, Powered by NIVO

Innovid’s growing suite of specialized agents is designed to execute high-impact tasks. Together, NIVO-powered agents help advertisers move from idea to execution to optimization with greater speed, ease, and impact.

Creative agents improve performance before and during campaigns:

  • Creative Generator Agent: Generate and adapt creative at scale.  
  • Predictive Scoring Agent: Anticipate performance before launch.  
    ‍

Deliver agents compress weeks of manual work into minutes:  

  • Campaign Trafficking Agent: Automatically build and traffic campaigns.
  • Campaign QA Agent: Catch errors before they go live.  
  • Decisioning Agent: Translate strategy into dynamic execution.  
  • Taxonomy Agent: Standardize taxonomy for cleaner data.  
    ‍

Measure agents surface instant performance insights  

  • Reporting Agent: Instantly answer performance questions across channels.  
  • Creative Insights Agent: Surface real-time creative asset level insights.
    ‍

Optimize agents refine in real time for better outcomes:

  • Creative Optimizer Agent: Continuously improve creative and campaign outcomes in-flight.
  • Reach and Frequency Agent: Identify overexposed and underexposed households in real time.


NIVO also extends intelligent orchestration across the broader advertising ecosystem through integrations with emerging AI frameworks and partner environments, including Meta ads AI connectors and AI-powered workflows from Snapchat. By connecting directly into platforms where marketers already operate, NIVO helps unify workflows, accelerate execution, and enable smarter decisioning across the AI-driven advertising lifecycle.  

‍

The Future of Agentic Advertising

The launch comes as the advertising industry increasingly shifts from AI experimentation toward execution and automation. Gartner recently reported 1 that 88% of CMOs expect generative AI to positively impact marketing investment and strategy, while identifying advertising optimization, workflow automation, analytics acceleration, and strategic creative development among the most valuable AI use cases for marketers.  

Recent Forrester research2 highlights that the most effective AI agent deployments are those that drive measurable operational efficiency gains, integrate into core business workflows, and scale across high volumes of work.  

NIVO brings together intelligence, orchestration, and execution into a more connected way of running advertising. With future applications being scoped across all Mediaocean surfaces and solutions, NIVO stands ready to transform the future for the entire industry. Visit www.innovid.com/nivo to see NIVO in action.

‍

About Innovid

Innovid is the leading omnichannel advertising platform, empowering marketers to create, deliver, measure, and optimize ad-supported experiences. At the core of Innovid is NIVO™, powering AI agents and orchestration to activate, adapt, and optimize campaigns across the advertising lifecycle.  As part of Mediaocean, Innovid is tied into Prisma, the industry’s core ad infrastructure for planning, buying, and billing, as well as Protected for verification, fraud detection, and brand safety. Visit www.innovid.com to learn more.
